{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check which species have missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]
print('Species with missing flipper_length_mm:')
print(missing_flipper[['species', 'flipper_length_mm']])

# Check the distribution of missingness by species
print('\nMissingness by species:')
print(penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum()))"}
